subject.title: Dashboard: widget write-back — a setState bridge capability + persisted widget state

question: Should OpenClaw accept dashboard widget write-back as a bundled dashboard capability, and what persistent storage/security boundary must the implementation use?
rationale: The request adds a new sandboxed-widget write path and persistent user state; repository policy does not let automation choose between JSON sidecar storage, plugin KV, or a SQLite-backed model for this new trust boundary.

options.title: Review the linked PR with a storage/security decision
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 as the candidate, but require a repository-compliant storage shape and adversarial security proof before merge.

options.title: Defer until Wave 1 dashboard foundations land
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause write-back review until the dashboard plugin, workspaces UI, and sandboxed widget host are merged and stable enough to extend.

options.title: Reject bundled write-back for now
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide custom widgets should remain read-only or state should live only in a future external plugin/API design.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR with a storage/security decision
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 as the candidate, but require a repository-compliant storage shape and adversarial security proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored and merged the current Logbook Control UI tab precedent and is the clearest owner signal for accepting a new bundled dashboard/security surface.
